title: The FCC vs the PRC - The Wire China
gist: Paywalled teaser on FCC chair Brendan Carr's aggressive regulatory campaign against China-linked entities, including an investigation into 'CCP-aligned entities'.

insights.claim: FCC chair Brendan Carr has quietly applied the same regulatory muscularity he shows toward U.S. broadcasters to China, making it a defining focus of his tenure.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: Chinese telecom, hardware and connected-device firms face rising U.S. licensing and market-access risk via the FCC.
insights.quote: But Carr has quietly brought the same muscularity to a challenge that has energized his career at the Federal Communications Commission: China.

insights.claim: The FCC has opened an investigation into 'CCP-aligned entities', extending telecom regulation into a national-security tool against China.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: FCC actions (equipment bans, license revocations) can abruptly cut Chinese vendors out of U.S. networks and retail channels.
insights.locator: An excerpt from an FCC press release

insights.claim: Carr is better known publicly for his feud with Jimmy Kimmel and investigations of news broadcasters, which obscures the scale of his China agenda.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: Underappreciated regulatory channel for U.S.-China tech decoupling.
